reason: 该插件的核心是界面增强：README明确其将 DSH 新建会话入口改为四步卡片向导，并在用户完成配置后再进入正常对话输入，因此主要面向会话启动流程的布局与交互优化。它属于UI体验类插件，核心能力是重定向并扩展新会话输入/配置界面。

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DSH Web 客户端插件，用四步卡片向导引导新建会话配置（任务模式、模型、会话参数、输入内容），并在确认后进入正常聊天输入。
summaries.en: This is a DSH Web client plugin that guides new-session setup through a four-step card wizard (task mode, model, session options, input) before entering the normal chat composer.

capabilities: Replaces the DSH new-session composer UI with a guided multi-step flow.
Collects model/agent preset/workspace/session settings before enabling first message send.
Persists a wizard-onboarding preference in browser localStorage.
Integrates with existing DSH client runtime services for session/model data.
Provides a fallback switch to the standard input interface.

reasons.code: Readme describes replacing the new-session screen with a four-step card wizard (任务模式/模型/配置/输入) and routing to normal chat after the first message.
Readme documents a browser localStorage preference key (dsh-new-session-cards:useWizard) and a settings toggle to return to the standard input mode.
package.json declares DSH client and bundle manifest entries plus injected client modules, showing it is a DSH browser plugin extension.
